views.credit: Design reference: Kohn Partnership Architects / City of Mississauga. Independent authored model: Daniel Sultan / Future Mississauga.
views.limits: Kohn application drawings dated July 30, 2026 inform the four visible elevations. The registered core, floor/roof levels and inherited south geometry remain exact. Bay widths, facade depth, guards, slab thickness, finishes and shallow podium treatment are illustrative; small plan recesses and garage interiors remain simplified. Inherited horizontal fit has a working +/-2 m allowance; architectural ASL minus 70 datum compatibility is not independently certified. Proposed application-stage design, not as-built.

views.credit: Design reference: Amacon / Parkside Village. Independent authored model: Daniel Sultan / Future Mississauga. Inherited registration sources include City of Mississauga and OpenStreetMap contributors.
views.limits: Existing source-plan shapes and registered tower datums are retained. City-facing piers, spandrels and glazing divisions interpret the official artist concept and August 2025 construction photos; their spacing and relief are approximate. No final roof or equipment geometry is asserted. The shorter height remains inferred with +/-6 m allowance; existing horizontal allowances are retained. This is an illustrative source-based model, not an as-built survey.
